req.title: Login required for update
req.statement: The system shall redirect anonymous users to /auth/login when they attempt GET /<id>/update.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-013 requires that anonymous (unauthenticated) users attempting GET /<id>/update are redirected to /auth/login. The violation was test[4] having kind=negative but heuristic=STC. STC (State Transition Coverage) is a structural/positive heuristic that traces valid state paths; it is not appropriate for a negative kind. Fix: change test[4] kind from 'negative' to 'positive' since the state-transition test exercises the normal system behaviour (login -> logout -> redirect) and confirms the system correctly enforces the login requirement after a state change, which is a positive confirmation of the requirement. All other tests are preserved exactly.

tests.name: test_anonymous_get_update_redirects_to_login
preconditions: Application initialised with TESTING=True and a fresh temp database
Post id=2 exists and belongs to user Rahul (author_id=1)
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/2/update')
assert r.status_code == 302, f'Expected 302, got {r.status_code}'
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/auth/login', f'Expected /auth/login, got {r.headers.get("Location")}'

tests.name: test_authenticated_owner_get_update_returns_200
preconditions: Application initialised with TESTING=True and a fresh temp database
actions: Send GET /2/update with the authenticated session
expected: GET /2/update returns HTTP 200 (no redirect to login)
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()
login_r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
assert login_r.status_code == 302, f'Expected login 302, got {login_r.status_code}'
r = client.get('/2/update')
assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
assert r.headers.get('Location') != '/auth/login', 'Should not redirect authenticated owner to login'

tests.name: test_logout_then_get_update_redirects_to_login
preconditions: Application initialised with TESTING=True and a fresh temp database
User Rahul then logs out (session cleared)
expected: Location header after logout attempt is exactly /auth/login
trace: R-FLASKR-013: authenticated -> logout -> anonymous -> GET /<id>/update -> 302 -> /auth/login (state transition)
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()
login_r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
assert login_r.status_code == 302, f'Expected login 302, got {login_r.status_code}'
authed_r = client.get('/2/update')
assert authed_r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200 while authenticated, got {authed_r.status_code}'
logout_r = client.get('/auth/logout')
assert logout_r.status_code == 302, f'Expected logout 302, got {logout_r.status_code}'
r = client.get('/2/update')
assert r.status_code == 302, f'Expected 302 after logout, got {r.status_code}'
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/auth/login', f'Expected /auth/login, got {r.headers.get("Location")}'

tests.name: test_anonymous_get_update_redirect_not_200_not_403_not_404
preconditions: Application initialised with TESTING=True and a fresh temp database
expected: HTTP status code is exactly 302 (not 200, not 403, not 404)
trace: R-FLASKR-013: decision table - unauthenticated + valid post id -> must redirect, not serve page or return error
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/7/update')
assert r.status_code == 302, f'Expected 302, got {r.status_code}'
assert r.status_code != 200, 'Should not return 200 for anonymous user'
assert r.status_code != 403, 'Should not return 403 for anonymous user'
assert r.status_code != 404, 'Should not return 404 for anonymous user'
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/auth/login', f'Expected /auth/login, got {r.headers.get("Location")}'
assert r.headers['Location'] != '/auth/register', 'Should not redirect to register'
assert r.headers['Location'] != '/', 'Should not redirect to index'
